description: This file defines utility classes for handling endianness conversions safely, wrapping integer types with automatic conversion methods, and includes macros for defining such types.

classes.name: Le16
classes.description: A class representing a 16-bit little-endian unsigned integer with automatic conversion methods.

classes.name: Le32
classes.description: A class representing a 32-bit little-endian unsigned integer with automatic conversion methods.

classes.name: Le64
classes.description: A class representing a 64-bit little-endian unsigned integer with automatic conversion methods.

classes.name: Be16
classes.description: A class representing a 16-bit big-endian unsigned integer with automatic conversion methods.

classes.description: A class representing a 32-bit big-endian unsigned integer with automatic conversion methods.

classes.description: A class representing a 64-bit big-endian unsigned integer with automatic conversion methods.
